code: #define _Complex #include <limits.h> #include <stdint.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <R.h> #include <Rinternals.h> #include <Rminibwa.h>  static int clamp_size_to_int(size_t x) {     return x > (size_t) INT_MAX ? INT_MAX : (int) x; }  SEXP rminibwa_capi_summary(SEXP align_x) {     const RmbAlignBatch *batch = Rminibwa_align_from_sexp(align_x);     const size_t n = Rminibwa_align_n(batch);     const size_t n_read = Rminibwa_align_n_read(batch);     const int32_t *read_len = Rminibwa_align_read_i32_col(batch, "length");     const int32_t *tid = Rminibwa_align_i32_col(batch, "tid");     const int32_t *qe = Rminibwa_align_i32_col(batch, "qe");     const int64_t *ts = Rminibwa_align_i64_col(batch, "ts");     size_t n_cigar_words = 0;     (void) Rminibwa_align_cigar_words(batch, &n_cigar_words);      SEXP out = PROTECT(Rf_allocVector(INTSXP, 5));     INTEGER(out)[0] = clamp_size_to_int(n);     INTEGER(out)[1] = clamp_size_to_int(n_read);     INTEGER(out)[2] = n_read && read_len ? read_len[0] : NA_INTEGER;     INTEGER(out)[3] = n && tid ? tid[0] : NA_INTEGER;     INTEGER(out)[4] = n && qe ? qe[0] : NA_INTEGER;      SEXP names = PROTECT(Rf_allocVector(STRSXP, 5));     SET_STRING_ELT(names, 0, Rf_mkChar("n"));     SET_STRING_ELT(names, 1, Rf_mkChar("n_read"));     SET_STRING_ELT(names, 2, Rf_mkChar("first_read_length"));     SET_STRING_ELT(names, 3, Rf_mkChar("first_tid"));     SET_STRING_ELT(names, 4, Rf_mkChar("first_qe"));     Rf_setAttrib(out, R_NamesSymbol, names);      /* Touch one 64-bit column so this example covers both integer-width paths. */     if (n_cigar_words == 0) INTEGER(out)[4] = NA_INTEGER;     if (n && ts && ts[0] < 0) INTEGER(out)[4] = NA_INTEGER;      UNPROTECT(2);     return out; }

title: Rminibwa 0.6.0-0.0.1.9000
text: Make Rduckhts required htslib provider. Configure now validates consumes exact installed linking receipt Unix Windows, rminibwa_htslib_info() verifies linked version build identity runtime. provides one verified htslib identity future native alignment-format work without selecting output architecture. Add Win32 file-mapping implementation vendored minibwa Windows Rtools builds longer require unavailable POSIX sys/mman.h. Add versioned, lossless native FASTQ query-group stream downstream native record consumers. installed C API exposes bounded one-template views, typed CIGAR/tag data, header facts, cooperative cancellation, explicit ownership/lifetime rules, exact read-group preservation, reason-coded paired FASTQ validation without SAM-text per-record-R-callback path. Update vendored minibwa exact upstream v0.6 release commit ebc59eaff045898c6a9daed4689302547d1326cb (MB_VERSION 0.6-r416; archive SHA256 f84b42299923ccfcab19f46bfdb7fdb4562d87c95cb0fc591823458474870474). includes paired-end mapQ revision, memory-mapped index loading, --outs, BS-seq API support, corrected -fixed insert-size distribution behavior upstream v0.5 v0.6.

title: Rminibwa 0.3.0-0.0.1.9000
text: Add MinGW/Rtools-kthread.c dead-return guard pthread_exit() avoid -Wreturn-type install warnings Windows. Make kseq.h’s kroundup64() width-safe 32-bit targets wasm32, avoiding Emscripten -Wshift-count-overflow diagnostics. Add mb_map_batch() native columnar mapping many query sequences one call, plus mb_map_pair_batch() explicit two-batch paired-end input. Add native FASTX iterators mb_map_fastx_batch() file-backed batches can mapped without materializing sequence strings R. Add read-level sidecar alignment batches read IDs, query lengths, fragment/mate fields, per-read hit offsets/counts, exposed ALTREP read columns C API. Add concise print method native alignment batches. Return simd_info() classed rminibwa_simd_info object concise print method dispatch diagnostics. Fold upstream minibwa v0.3 / MB_VERSION 0.3-r391 commit a679d17cb822c6cca67ab78c439f9c9826f1b07d. Switch package versions <minibwa-version>-<Rminibwa-version> scheme; development builds now use 0.3.0-0.0.1.9000. Add MinGW/Rtools-kalloc.c format-string guard size_t diagnostics leaving non-MinGW upstream code path unchanged.

title: Rminibwa 0.0.0.9000
text: Bootstrap Rminibwa GPL (>= 2) R package wrapping pinned upstream lh3/minibwa C sources. Add native bindings index build/load, raw-vector query mapping, native external-pointer alignment batches, ALTREP column views, packed CIGAR accessors. Install inst/include/Rminibwa.h register C-callable accessors downstream packages can consume alignment batches directly C. Add staged KSW SIMD dispatch following RsimdDispatch pattern: portable scalar/SIMDe fallback, SSE4, AVX2 backends compiled separate objects selected runtime without global ISA compiler flags. Add AVX2 dual-gap extd2 support minibwa binding work keep optional runtime-dispatched backend. Vendor minibwa commit f0fd108456d459e5da3755f29c8700dc7f6fe0df patch queue provenance metadata. Add Rtinycc inline downstream-C examples README, vignette, tests. Build install package-provided minibwa executable vendored sources; CLI wrappers now use default. Add developer-benchmarks comparing internal staged backends optional external Python/Rust bindings explicit local checkout. Add make asm / tools/check-assembly.R audit generated SIMD instruction families staged objects shared libraries. Add pkgdown configuration GitHub Actions workflows standard R CMD check, Fedora/R-devel CRAN-style check, GitHub Pages deployment.
